<DIV><P align=right style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:4pt'><FONT style=font-size:12pt><B>EXHIBIT 10.5</B></FONT></P>
<P align=center style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:8pt'><FONT style=font-size:12pt><B>Contract for the Partial Definitive Transfer of Rights under Concession Title No. 08JAL153529/12AMDA12 (60,000 m&#179; per year), dated August 20, 2022, between J. Jes&#250;s P&#233;rez D&#237;az, as transferor, and Juan Pablo Mu&#241;oz Flores, as transferee, ratified before Notary Public No. 43 of Guadalajara, Jalisco on August 24, 2022 (English translation)</B></FONT></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:12pt'><FONT style=font-size:9.5pt><I>English translation prepared by the registrant from the Spanish original (pages 1 through 4 of the executed document). The remaining pages of the scanned original (a notarial fee estimate relating to a different property, a tax computation, and duplicate copies of the contract pages) are not part of the agreement and are omitted. Personal identifying information of individuals (tax identification numbers, home addresses and personal data recited in the notarial certification) has been omitted pursuant to It</I><I>em 601(a)(6) of Regulation S-K and is marked [</I><B><I>*]. The Spanish original will be furnished to the Commission upon request.</I></B></FONT></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>CONTRACT FOR THE PARTIAL DEFINITIVE TRANSFER OF RIGHTS UNDER CONCESSION TITLE NO. 08JAL153529/12AMDA12 TO EXPLOIT, USE OR BENEFIT FROM NATIONAL SUBSOIL WATERS, ENTERED INTO, ON THE ONE PART, BY J. JES&#218;S P&#201;REZ D&#205;AZ, ACTING THROUGH HIS LEGAL ATTORNEY-IN-FACT, MR. FRANCISCO JAVIER GUTI&#201;RREZ GARC&#205;A, AS &#8220;TRANSFEROR&#8221;, AND, ON THE OTHER PART, BY MR. JUAN PABLO MU&#209;OZ FLORES, AS &#8220;TRANSFEREE&#8221;, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE FOLLOWING REPRESENTATIONS AND CLAUSES:</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><FONT style=font-size:10pt><I>[Translator&#8217;s note: the first page bears the handwritten annotation &#8220;Se compr&#243; a 16.00 pesos m3&#8221; (&#8220;Purchased at 16.00 pesos per m&#179;&#8221;).]</I></FONT></P>
<P align=center style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>REPRESENTATIONS</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>Representations of the &#8220;TRANSFEROR&#8221; (through his legal attorney-in-fact)</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>I. That J. Jes&#250;s P&#233;rez D&#237;az is of Mexican nationality, with Federal Taxpayer Registry (RFC) No. [<B>*], domiciled at [</B>*], Municipality of Tala, Jalisco, and with address for notices at [<B>*], Guadalajara, Jalisco.</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>II. That on June 4, 2013, the National Water Commission (Comisi&#243;n Nacional del Agua) granted him Concession Title No. 08JAL153529/12AMDA12 to exploit, use or benefit from national subsoil waters for agricultural use, the point of use of which is located at the property &#8220;Corral Falso o Parcela 414 Z1 P1/3,&#8221; located in Tala, Jalisco.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>III. That the Concession Title subject of this transfer is registered in the Public Registry of Water Rights (Registro P&#250;blico de Derechos de Agua) as of April 23, 2013, with a term of 10 years commencing June 5, 2013.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>IV. That the concessionaire is current in the payment of the taxes and governmental charges relating to water for which he is responsible.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>V. That the characteristics of the current use are the following:</P>

<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:4pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>Representations of the &#8220;TRANSFEREE&#8221;</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>I. That Juan Pablo Mu&#241;oz Flores is of Mexican nationality, an individual, with Federal Taxpayer Registry (RFC) No. [<B>*], domiciled at [</B>*], Tequila, Jalisco, C.P. 46400, and with address for notices at [<B>*], Guadalajara, Jalisco.</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>II. That he meets the characteristics and requirements set forth in the National Water Law (Ley de Aguas Nacionales) and its regulations to be a concessionaire.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>III. That he wishes to acquire from the user a volume of 60,000.00 m&#179; per year.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>IV. That the use he will give to the national waters subject of this transfer of rights will be: Agricultural.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>V. That the new use of the national waters will be the following:</P>
<TABLE style=border-collapse:collapse><TR><TD valign=top style=width:234pt;padding-left:5.4pt;padding-right:5.4pt><P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Coordinates</P>
</TD><TD valign=top style=width:234pt;padding-left:5.4pt;padding-right:5.4pt><P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Latitude 20&#176;02&#8242;35.10&#8243;; Longitude 103&#176;34&#8242;42.76&#8243;</P>
</TD></TR>
<TR><TD valign=top style=width:234pt;padding-left:5.4pt;padding-right:5.4pt><P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Property Name</P>
</TD><TD valign=top style=width:234pt;padding-left:5.4pt;padding-right:5.4pt><P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Barranca de San Miguel y Ozotera</P>
</TD></TR>
<TR><TD valign=top style=width:234pt;padding-left:5.4pt;padding-right:5.4pt><P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Annex to be modified</P>

<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:4pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>Both parties declare that by means of this transfer the characteristics of the concession title are modified, and that they therefore execute this contract in the full exercise of their will, without error, violence, fraud, bad faith or any other defect affecting their free consent, and without prejudice to the rights of third parties, and accordingly they agree to the following:</P>
<P align=center style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>CLAUSES</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>FIRST.</B> The &#8220;TRANSFEROR&#8221; transfers definitive ownership of the rights under Concession Title 08JAL153529/12AMDA12 to exploit, use or benefit from national subsoil waters: 60,000.00 m&#179;.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>SECOND.</B> The &#8220;TRANSFEREE&#8221; is subrogated to the rights and obligations arising from the Concession Title referred to in the First Clause, as from the execution of this instrument, pursuant to Article 36 of the National Water Law.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>THIRD.</B> The &#8220;TRANSFEREE&#8221; undertakes not to put the rights transferred under this agreement to a different use without the prior authorization of the National Water Commission.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>FOURTH.</B> The &#8220;TRANSFEREE&#8221; undertakes to comply with the conditions and terms set forth in the concession title authorized to him and not to vary them without the prior authorization of the National Water Commission.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>FIFTH.</B> The &#8220;TRANSFEROR&#8221; and the &#8220;TRANSFEREE&#8221; assume joint and several liability to compensate any damages that, as the case may be and as a consequence of this contract, may be caused to third parties; likewise, where applicable, this contract is subject to the provisions of Article 72 of the Regulations of the National Water Law.</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>SIXTH.</B> The &#8220;TRANSFEREE&#8221; is jointly and severally liable for any amounts that may be owed by the TRANSFEROR for unpaid taxes and governmental charges related to the use covered by the Concession Title referred to in the First Clause and arising prior to the execution of this contract.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>SEVENTH.</B> In the event of any controversy related to the interpretation or performance of this contract, the contracting parties expressly submit to conciliation and, as the case may be, to the arbitration of the National Water Commission.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>EIGHTH.</B> This contract is signed by those who participate in the transfer of rights: the &#8220;TRANSFEROR,&#8221; through his Legal Representative, and the &#8220;TRANSFEREE.&#8221;</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>This contract consists of four sheets and, the parties having read it and understood its contents, it is signed in triplicate by the parties who intervened in it, in the town of Tequila, Jalisco, on August 20, 2022, before two witnesses of legal age who attest and fully identify themselves, a copy of their current official identification being attached.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>&#8220;TRANSFEROR&#8221;: [signature] Mr. J. Jes&#250;s P&#233;rez D&#237;az, by signature of his Legal Attorney-in-Fact, Francisco Javier Guti&#233;rrez Garc&#237;a</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>&#8220;TRANSFEREE&#8221;: [signature] Mr. Juan Pablo Mu&#241;oz Flores</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>ATTESTING WITNESSES: First Witness: [signature] Mr. C&#233;sar Alejandro Guti&#233;rrez Hern&#225;ndez. Second Witness: [signature] Mr. J. Uvaldo Torres Paniagua.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'><I>[Each page of the contract bears in the margin the signature of Juan Pablo Mu&#241;oz Flores and the signature of the transferor&#8217;s attorney-in-fact, and at the foot the signature of J. Uvaldo Torres Paniagua.]</I></P>
<P align=center style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>NOTARIAL RATIFICATION</B></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>NUMBER: 10,375 (TEN THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED SEVENTY-FIVE). VOLUME: 17 (SEVENTEEN).</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>In the city of Guadalajara, Jalisco, at 10:00 a.m. on August 24, 2022, before me, LICENCIADO FELIPE DE JES&#218;S PRECIADO CORONADO, Titular Notary Public No. 43 of this Municipality, appeared, on the one part, MR. FRANCISCO JAVIER GUTI&#201;RREZ GARC&#205;A, as Legal Attorney-in-Fact of MR. J. JES&#218;S P&#201;REZ D&#205;AZ, evidencing his capacity by the original certified copy of public instrument No. 31,523, granted on June 29 of this year before Licenciado Edmundo M&#225;rquez Hern&#225;ndez, Notary Public No. 3 of the Municipality of Tlajomulco de Z&#250;&#241;iga, Jalisco, which contains a GENERAL POWER OF ATTORNEY FOR LITIGATION, FOR ACTS OF ADMINISTRATION AND FOR ACTS OF OWNERSHIP LIMITED TO THE PROPERTY SUBJECT OF THIS CONTRACT, Mr. Francisco Javier Guti&#233;rrez Garc&#237;a declaring under penalty of perjury that the powers with which he appears to sign this instrument have not been revoked or limited in any way and therefore remain in force, which document I attest to having seen in original and of which I add a simple copy to my book of documents corresponding to this certification; [personal data of the attorney-in-fact and of Mr. J. Jes&#250;s P&#233;rez D&#237;az omitted: [<B>*]]; and appearing on the other part, on his own behalf, MR. JUAN PABLO MU&#209;OZ FLORES, [personal data omitted: [</B>*]], passing through this city; who, in accordance with Article 84, section VIII, of the Notarial Law in force in the State of Jalisco, identified themselves with their respective official documents, which I attest to having seen and of which I add simple photocopies to my corresponding book of documents; whom I deemed to have legal capacity to contract and bind themselves; and THEY STATED THAT THEY RATIFY THIS CONTRACT, AS WELL AS THE SIGNATURES APPEARING </P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#0000A0;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>THEREON, SIGNING AND PLACING THEIR FINGERPRINTS AGAIN IN MY PRESENCE, WHICH I CERTIFY AND ATTEST.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>I RECORDED THE FOREGOING IN MY BOOK OF NOTARIAL CERTIFICATIONS.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>I READ THE FOREGOING TO THE APPEARING PARTIES, WHO, BEING IN AGREEMENT WITH ITS CONTENTS, RATIFIED IT, PLACED THEIR FINGERPRINTS AND SIGNED BEFORE ME.</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>[Signature and fingerprint] FRANCISCO JAVIER GUTI&#201;RREZ GARC&#205;A, Legal Attorney-in-Fact of Mr. J. Jes&#250;s P&#233;rez D&#237;az</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>[Signature and fingerprint] JUAN PABLO MU&#209;OZ FLORES</P>
<P style='font:11pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:12pt'>[Signature and seal] LIC. FELIPE DE JES&#218;S PRECIADO CORONADO, Notary Public No. 43 of this Municipality, Guadalajara, Jalisco</P>
